SELECT R.RQST_NO, R.RQST_LOGIN_ID, R.RQST_MNGR_NM, R.RQST_DUTY_CD, R.RQST_DT, R.APRV_DT, R.RQST_STTS_CD AS RQST_STTS_CD, R.APRV_ID, R.RJCT_RSN_CN, R.RMRK_CN, R.USER_NO, R.ACNT_DSPLY_YN,
G.MGMT_OFC_NO, G.MNGR_DUTY_CD,
O.APT_CMPLEX_NO, A.APT_CMPLEX_NM,
CASE R.RQST_DUTY_CD WHEN 'DUTY_HEAD' THEN '관리소장' WHEN 'DUTY_ACC' THEN '회계' WHEN 'DUTY_ADMIN' THEN '행정' WHEN 'DUTY_FAC' THEN '시설' WHEN 'HEAD' THEN '관리소장' WHEN 'ACNT' THEN '회계' WHEN 'ADM' THEN '행정' WHEN 'FAC' THEN '시설' ELSE R.RQST_DUTY_CD END AS DUTY_NM,
CASE R.RQST_STTS_CD WHEN 'WAIT' THEN '승인대기' WHEN 'OK' THEN '승인완료' WHEN 'RJCT' THEN '반려' WHEN 'CNL' THEN '신청취소' END AS STTS_NM
FROM MNGR_RQST R
LEFT JOIN MANAGER G ON R.USER_NO = G.USER_NO
LEFT JOIN MGMT_OFFICE O ON G.MGMT_OFC_NO = O.MGMT_OFC_NO
LEFT JOIN APT_COMPLEX A ON O.APT_CMPLEX_NO = A.APT_CMPLEX_NO
AND ( LOWER(R.RQST_MNGR_NM) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(R.RQST_LOGIN_ID) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(A.APT_CMPLEX_NM) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
AND LOWER(R.RQST_STTS_CD) = LOWER(#{status})
AND ( R.RQST_DUTY_CD = #{role} OR G.MNGR_DUTY_CD = #{role} )
AND NVL(R.ACNT_DSPLY_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
ORDER BY R.RQST_DT DESC, R.RQST_NO DESC

SELECT M.USER_NO, M.USER_ID, M.USER_NM, M.USER_TELNO, M.USER_EML, M.USER_YN, M.REG_DT, M.MDFCN_DT,
G.MGMT_OFC_NO, G.MNGR_DUTY_CD,
O.APT_CMPLEX_NO, A.APT_CMPLEX_NM,
/* CASE란? → DB 코드값을 화면용 한글명으로 바꾸는 SQL 문법. 왜 사용? → DB에는 HEAD, ACNT 같은 코드로 저장하고 화면에는 관리소장, 회계처럼 보여주기 위해 사용. */ CASE G.MNGR_DUTY_CD WHEN 'DUTY_HEAD' THEN '관리소장' WHEN 'DUTY_ACC' THEN '회계' WHEN 'DUTY_ADMIN' THEN '행정' WHEN 'DUTY_FAC' THEN '시설' WHEN 'HEAD' THEN '관리소장' WHEN 'ACNT' THEN '회계' WHEN 'ADM' THEN '행정' WHEN 'FAC' THEN '시설' ELSE G.MNGR_DUTY_CD END AS DUTY_NM,
TO_CHAR(NVL(M.MDFCN_DT, M.REG_DT), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS LAST_LOGIN_DT, TO_CHAR(NVL(M.MDFCN_DT, M.REG_DT), 'HH24:MI') AS LAST_LOGIN_TM
FROM MEMBER M
/* INNER JOIN이 아니라 LEFT JOIN으로 둔 이유: → AUTH나 MANAGER 데이터가 빠졌는지 확인하기 쉽게 하기 위함. 단, WHERE에서 ROLE_MNGR 조건을 걸어 실제 관리자 권한만 조회한다. */ LEFT JOIN AUTH AU ON M.USER_NO = AU.USER_NO
LEFT JOIN MANAGER G ON M.USER_NO = G.USER_NO
LEFT JOIN MGMT_OFFICE O ON G.MGMT_OFC_NO = O.MGMT_OFC_NO
LEFT JOIN APT_COMPLEX A ON O.APT_CMPLEX_NO = A.APT_CMPLEX_NO
WHERE AU.USER_ROLE_CD = 'ROLE_MNGR' AND G.USER_NO IS NOT NULL
AND M.USER_YN = 'Y'
AND ( LOWER(M.USER_NM) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(M.USER_ID) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(A.APT_CMPLEX_NM) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
AND M.USER_YN = 'Y'
AND M.USER_YN = 'N'
AND G.MNGR_DUTY_CD = #{role}
ORDER BY M.REG_DT DESC, M.USER_NO DESC

SELECT M.USER_NO, M.USER_ID, M.USER_NM, M.USER_TELNO, M.USER_EML, M.USER_YN, M.REG_DT, M.MDFCN_DT,
G.MGMT_OFC_NO, G.MNGR_DUTY_CD,
O.APT_CMPLEX_NO, A.APT_CMPLEX_NM,
CASE G.MNGR_DUTY_CD WHEN 'DUTY_HEAD' THEN '관리소장' WHEN 'DUTY_ACC' THEN '회계' WHEN 'DUTY_ADMIN' THEN '행정' WHEN 'DUTY_FAC' THEN '시설' WHEN 'HEAD' THEN '관리소장' WHEN 'ACNT' THEN '회계' WHEN 'ADM' THEN '행정' WHEN 'FAC' THEN '시설' ELSE G.MNGR_DUTY_CD END AS DUTY_NM,
TO_CHAR(NVL(M.MDFCN_DT, M.REG_DT), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS LAST_LOGIN_DT, TO_CHAR(NVL(M.MDFCN_DT, M.REG_DT), 'HH24:MI') AS LAST_LOGIN_TM
FROM MEMBER M
JOIN AUTH AU ON M.USER_NO = AU.USER_NO AND AU.USER_ROLE_CD = 'ROLE_MNGR'
JOIN MANAGER G ON M.USER_NO = G.USER_NO
LEFT JOIN MGMT_OFFICE O ON G.MGMT_OFC_NO = O.MGMT_OFC_NO
LEFT JOIN APT_COMPLEX A ON O.APT_CMPLEX_NO = A.APT_CMPLEX_NO
WHERE M.USER_NO = #{userNo}
